activities.description: Pointing out the top part connecting to the femur.
Showing and naming the medial and lateral condyles.
Showing the medial malleolus at the bottom.

characterInteraction.description: The narrator speaks directly to the viewer, explaining the features of the bone.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Introduction to the tibia bone and its key features.

mood.description: Curious, informative. The visuals and neutral tone of the narrator contribute to a learning environment.

narrativeProgression.description: The narrator introduces the tibia bone.
The connection point to the femur is explained.
Condyles are introduced and differentiated as medial and lateral.
Intercondylar eminence is identified and located.
Tibial tuberosity's location and texture are described.
The anterior border is traced along the bone.
The medial malleolus is shown and named.

text_to_speech: Okay so this is the tibia. So this is the top part of the tibia where it would connect with the femur itself. So just like the femur we've got the two condyles you've got your medial and your lateral. Okay then we have our intercondylar eminence which is this raised part right here. We have the tibial tuberosity right here kind of in the front it's a raised region roughened region. This whole section here is the anterior border and then at the bottom you can see this one large projection here that's the medial malleolus.
